description: This file defines the Sponsor class within the Goteo model, representing sponsors for calls with methods for retrieving, listing, validating, and saving sponsor data, as well as managing sponsor order.

classes.name: Sponsor
classes.description: Model class representing a call sponsor, including properties for sponsor attributes and methods for database interactions and business logic.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sponsor by ID from the database, optionally fetching its associated image.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all sponsors associated with a specific call.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of sponsors based on call, type, and additional filters.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the sponsor data, checking for required fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current sponsor object to the database, handling image upload and replacement.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Reorders the sponsor to appear higher (earlier) in the list.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Reorders the sponsor to appear lower (later) in the list.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order position for adding a new sponsor.
